updates.title: CVE-2026-69836: Microsoft Entra ID Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: A deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID could allow unauthorized attackers to execute code remotely over the network. Admins should prioritize patching to prevent potential compromise of identity infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69851: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw in Azure Active Directory allows authorized attackers to escalate their privileges over the network. This post-authentication vulnerability requires immediate attention to protect administrative access.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62827: Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authentication in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges across the network. Organizations using SharePoint for sensitive data storage should apply patches to prevent privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-63512: Microsoft SharePoint Server Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authorization bypass in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to tamper with content over the network. This could compromise data integrity and compliance posture for organizations storing regulated content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Protection for Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: DLP policies now extend to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches, adding critical controls for AI-driven data leakage risks. This launched feature helps organizations reduce exposure of confidential information through AI interactions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Tips Now Available in Outlook for Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips are now supported in Outlook for Mac, providing real-time notifications when users compose emails containing sensitive data. This launched feature ensures Mac users receive the same compliance warnings as their Windows counterparts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logs in Purview will provide greater transparency into role and scoped-role access decisions, enabling admins to troubleshoot authorization issues more effectively. This visibility improvement supports access governance and compliance monitoring.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery Support for SharePoint Embedded Containers
updates.summary: eDiscovery now allows selection of user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers (from Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks) as data sources. This expands investigative coverage for modern collaboration workloads.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery Direct Export with Customer-Managed Keys
updates.summary: eDiscovery direct export now supports customer-managed key (CMK) encryption, allowing organizations to control encryption keys for exported content. This feature enhances control and compliance for sensitive litigation and investigation scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations from Endpoint DLP Alerts
updates.summary: Admins can now launch Data Security Investigations directly from endpoint DLP alerts to automatically gather and analyze files that triggered alerts. This streamlines investigation workflows for suspected data exfiltration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Triage Agent with Reasoning Trace and Confidence Scoring
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent in DLP now surfaces reasoning traces and confidence scores with each decision, enabling security teams to assess reliability of agent recommendations. This transparency supports faster, more confident alert triage and reduces reliance on manual review.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Alert Summaries Available in Microsoft Defender XDR
updates.summary: Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will now surface in Microsoft Defender XDR, centralizing security insights across identity and data protection tools. This integration improves visibility for SOC teams managing multi-cloud security posture.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management for Copilot Memory Retention
updates.summary: Admins can now configure retention policies for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory, enabling preservation and versioning of saved memories and inferred chat history stored in Exchange mailboxes. This supports compliance and investigation scenarios for AI-assisted work.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Retention Based on Last Accessed Date for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Retention policies can now trigger based on when files were last accessed by users, enabling more granular content lifecycle management. This feature helps organizations retain actively used data while disposing of long-dormant content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Secure Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint Retention
updates.summary: Data Lifecycle Management now supports hard deletion of content through secure priority cleanup workflows with enhanced safeguards. This feature includes multi-approval requirements to prevent inadvertent data loss during compliance-driven deletions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Before enforcing auto-labeling policies, admins can now run them in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled without making changes. This testing capability reduces the risk of unintended classifications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policy Insights Dashboard
updates.summary: The new Insights tab in auto-labeling policy details shows at-a-glance performance metrics, helping admins understand how policies identify and label content in both simulation and enforcement modes.
